examples.chinese: 你覺得華語好學嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde Huáyǔ hǎo xué ma?
examples.english: Do you think Chinese is easy to learn?

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese:
如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。
為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin:
Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn.
Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english:
If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test.
In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 這個學期中文課的新教材是時代華語第三冊，一共有十六課。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Zhōngwén kè de xīn jiàocái shì Shídài Huáyǔ dì-sān cè, yígòng yǒu shíliù kè.
examples.english: This semester’s new Chinese course teaching material is Modern Chinese Volume 3, which has sixteen lessons in total.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

items.wordHook: 華(Chinese) + 語(words) → the words of Chinese, meaning the Chinese language.

examples.chinese: 你手裡拿的東西是什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǒu lǐ ná de dōngxī shì shénme?
examples.english: What is the thing you are holding in your hand?

examples.chinese: 帶這麼重的東西，走了兩個小時，我覺得很累。
examples.pinyin: Dài zhème zhòng de dōngxī, zǒu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, wǒ juéde hěn lèi.
examples.english: Carrying such heavy things and walking for two hours, I feel very tired.

examples.chinese: 我肚子餓了，想吃點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dùzi è le, xiǎng chī diǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: My belly is hungry; I want to eat something.

examples.chinese: 女生和男生都喜歡去百貨公司買東西。
examples.pinyin: Nǚshēng hé nánshēng dōu xǐhuān qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: Both girls and boys like to go to the department store to shop.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 這家商店的東西很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de dōngxi hěn piányi.
examples.english: Stuff in this store is quite cheap.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.
examples.english: These stuff cost twenty three thousand, five hundred and five dollars in total.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 你要買什麼東西？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào mǎi shénme dōngxi?
examples.english: What stuff are you going to buy?

examples.chinese: 是因為吃的東西不乾淨嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shì yīnwèi chī de dōngxi bù gānjìng ma?
examples.english: Is it because of having contaminated food?

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 咖啡、茶，我都喜歡。我也很餓，想吃一點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, chá, wǒ dōu xǐhuān. Wǒ yě hěn è, xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: Coffee and tea, I like them both. I am also hungry; I would like to have some food.

examples.chinese: 很可愛，友美喜歡可愛的東西。
examples.pinyin: Hěn kěài. Yǒuměi xǐhuān kěài de dōngxi.
examples.english: It’s very cute. Youmei likes cute stuff.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
examples.pinyin: Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 我不認為地攤沒好貨，有一些地攤的東西不僅價格便宜，品質也不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú rènwéi dìtān méi hǎohuò, yǒu yìxiē dìtān de dōngxi bùjǐn jiàgé piányi, pǐnzhì yě búcuò.
examples.english: I don't think street stalls have no good goods; some stall items are not only cheap in price, but the quality is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài zhè dòng gōngyù zhù le shí nián le, bānjiā shí, yòng le hǎo jǐ ge dà xiāngzi lái zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.english: Grandpa has lived in this apartment building for ten years; when moving, he used several large boxes to pack things.

examples.chinese:
我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。
我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo.
Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english:
I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good.
My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese:
我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。
颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī.
Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english:
Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house.
The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 我往東走，你往西走，我們兩個的方向剛好相反。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu, nǐ wǎng xī zǒu, wǒmen liǎng gè de fāngxiàng gānghǎo xiāngfǎn.
examples.english: I walk east, you walk west; our two directions are exactly opposite.

examples.chinese: 有人信上帝，有人不信。但在東西方的文化中，「上帝」的角色都是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xìn Shàngdì, yǒu rén bú xìn. Dàn zài dōng xīfāng de wénhuà zhōng, “Shàngdì” de juésè dōu shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Some people believe in God, and some do not. But in both Eastern and Western cultures, the role of “God” is very important.

examples.chinese:
博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。
每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin:
Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de.
Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english:
The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money.
Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

items.wordHook: 一(one) 儿(child) crawls through the 口(opening) toward the setting sun → 西(west).

examples.chinese: 牆上掛著的那張畫是我爸爸畫的。
examples.pinyin: Qiángshàng guà zhe de nà zhāng huà shì wǒ bàba huà de.
examples.english: That painting hanging on the wall was painted by my dad.

examples.chinese: 這面牆壁上的圖畫真美，是誰畫的？
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiángbì shàng de túhuà zhēn měi, shì shéi huà de?
examples.english: The picture on this wall is really beautiful—who painted it?

examples.chinese: 我沒有帶大門的鑰匙，不得不攀牆進去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dài dàmén de yàoshi, bùdébù pān qiáng jìnqù.
examples.english: I didn't bring the key to the main door, so I had no choice but to climb over the wall to get in.

examples.chinese: 我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài chuáng pángbiān bǎi ge shūzhuō, búguò kōngjiān bú tài gòu, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎ chuáng yí dào qiáng biān ma?
examples.english: I want to put a desk next to the bed, but there isn't quite enough space. Could you help me move the bed to the wall?

examples.chinese: 這本書只能借到下個禮拜一，再看兩天就得還了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhǐ néng jiè dào xià ge lǐbài yī, zài kàn liǎng tiān jiù děi huán le.
examples.english: This book can only be borrowed until next Monday; after reading it for two more days, I will have to return it.

examples.chinese: 這本書只能借到下個禮拜一，再看兩天就得還了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhǐ néng jiè dào xià ge lǐbài yī, zài kàn liǎng tiān jiù děi huán le.
examples.english: This book can only be borrowed until next Monday; after reading it for two more days, I will have to return it.

examples.chinese: 我最近窮死了，連三明治也吃不起，只好跟朋友借錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn qióng sǐ le, lián sānmíngzhì yě chī bù qǐ, zhǐhǎo gēn péngyǒu jièqián.
examples.english: I've been dirt poor lately. I can't even afford a sandwich, so I have to borrow money from friends.

examples.chinese: 李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank.

examples.chinese: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué jì bǐjì de sùdù hěn kuài, yě jì de hěn qīngchu, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐjì lái fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: My classmate takes notes very quickly and also remembers them very clearly, so I often borrow his notes to review my lessons.

examples.chinese:
跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。
A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin:
Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén.
A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english:
Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people.
A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 向圖書館借的書籍要是超過規定的時間沒還，可是要罰錢的。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng túshūguǎn jiè de shūjí yàoshi chāoguò guīdìng de shíjiān méi huán, kěshì yào fá qián de.
examples.english: If books borrowed from the library are not returned within the stipulated time, you will indeed be fined money.

examples.chinese: 本市的市立圖書館的書籍豐富，來借書的民眾也不少。
examples.pinyin: Běn shì de shìlì túshūguǎn de shūjí fēngfù, lái jiè shū de mínzhòng yě bùshǎo.
examples.english: The city's municipal library has a rich collection of books, and there are also many people who come to borrow books.

examples.chinese: 你老是批評別人，誰想跟你做朋友呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lǎoshì pīpíng biérén, shéi xiǎng gēn nǐ zuò péngyǒu ne?
examples.english: You are always criticizing others; who would want to be friends with you?

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: 要是你對文藝領域不了解，最好不要隨便批評別人的作品。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ duì wényì lǐngyù bù liǎojiě, zuìhǎo bùyào suíbiàn pīpíng biérén de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: If you don't understand the field of literature and art, you'd better not casually criticize others' works.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese:
因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。
不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le.
Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english:
Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over.
Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì bàogào gěi lǎoshī qián zuìhǎo quèrèn yīxià dìzhǐ, wànyī lǎoshī méi shōudào, dào shí nǐ jiù máfan le.
examples.english: Before you mail the report to the teacher, you'd better confirm the address; if the teacher doesn't receive it, you'll be in trouble when the moment comes.

examples.chinese: 開車時萬一發生車禍，千萬要冷靜，以免情況更嚴重。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí wànyī fāshēng chēhuò, qiānwàn yào lěngjìng, yǐmiǎn qíngkuàng gèng yánzhòng.
examples.english: If a car accident happens while driving, one must by all means stay calm, so as to avoid the situation becoming more serious.

examples.chinese: 黃小姐為家人買了定期健康保險，萬一有需要時就可以減輕負擔。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě wèi jiārén mǎi le dìngqī jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn, wànyī yǒu xūyào shí jiù kěyǐ jiǎnqīng fùdān.
examples.english: Miss Huang bought regular health insurance for her family, so that if there is a need, it can reduce the burden.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese:
理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。
著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng.
Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english:
In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation.
The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
examples.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

examples.chinese: 汽車的汽油燃燒不完全的話，容易產生很多廢氣。
examples.pinyin: Qìchē de qìyóu ránshāo bù wánquán de huà, róngyì chǎnshēng hěn duō fèiqì.
examples.english: If a car's gasoline does not burn completely, it easily produces a lot of exhaust fumes.

examples.chinese: 水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ hé bīng jīběnshàng shì xiāngtóng de, zhǐshì yīn wēndù ér chǎnshēng bùtóng de biànhuà.
examples.english: Water and ice are basically the same; they just undergo different changes due to temperature.

examples.chinese: 根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng zīliào, zhège táifēng wèilái liǎng tiān huì wǎng xī yídòng, zhōuwǔ qǐ duì Táiwān chǎnshēng yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: According to meteorological data, this typhoon will move westward over the next two days and will begin to affect Taiwan from Friday.

examples.chinese: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
examples.pinyin: Dāng sēnlín jiànjiàn cóng dìqiú shàng xiāoshī shí, kěnéng shǐ quánqiú qìhòu chǎnshēng zhòngdà de biànhuà.
examples.english: When forests gradually disappear from the Earth, it may cause major changes in the global climate.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

items.wordHook: Engaged in 產(give birth) study during student 生(life): 產生 means produce, to engender.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 如果從事某項工作能令你忘掉時間，或許就可當作一生的事業。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ cóngshì mǒu xiàng gōngzuò néng lìng nǐ wàngdiào shíjiān, huòxǔ jiù kě dàngzuò yīshēng de shìyè.
examples.english: If being engaged in a certain job can make you forget time, perhaps it can be treated as a lifelong career.

examples.chinese: 為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gèrén shìyè ér fàngxià xuéyè, duōshù rén shì hěn nán zuòdào de.
examples.english: To give up one's studies in order to develop a personal career is something most people find very hard to do.

examples.chinese: 聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi xīnláng zài shìyè shàng hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kuàngqiě yōudiǎn yě bù shǎo, gēn tā jiéhūn de nǚrén yīnggāi hěn xìngfú.
examples.english: I heard that bridegroom has great achievements in his career, and moreover has many good qualities; the woman who marries him should be very happy.

examples.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
examples.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

items.wordHook: Combining 事(affair) and 業(business): 事業 means career.

examples.chinese: 白天沙漠裡的沙子很燙(to be scalded)，要是光著腳，一定會被燙傷的。
examples.pinyin: Báitiān shāmò lǐ de shāzi hěn tàng, yàoshi guāngzhe jiǎo, yídìng huì bèi tàngshāng de.
examples.english: During the day, the sand in the desert is very hot; if you go barefoot, you will definitely get burned.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，食物營養不營養無所謂，只要好吃就行了。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, shíwù yíngyǎng bù yíngyǎng wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào hǎochī jiù xíng le.
examples.english: To me, whether food is nutritious or not doesn't matter; as long as it's tasty, that's fine.

examples.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
examples.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

examples.chinese: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ biàn huáng de shūcài yèzi mái zài dì lǐ, ràng tā biànchéng cǎodì de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Grandma buried the yellowed vegetable leaves in the ground, letting them become nutrition for the lawn.

examples.chinese: 要想擁有好身材，除了注意營養，還得多運動。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái, chúle zhùyì yíngyǎng, hái děi duō yùndòng.
examples.english: If you want to have a good figure, besides paying attention to nutrition, you also need to exercise more.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。
examples.pinyin: Shèngxià de fàncài jiārè tài duō cì, jiù méi shénme yíngyǎng le, zuìhǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng.
examples.english: If leftover food is heated too many times, it loses its nutrition; it's best to finish it all at each meal.

examples.chinese: 為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。
examples.pinyin: Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, māma měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ zhǔnbèi yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān, ràng wǒmen yì tiān de kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīngshén.
examples.english: For the family's health, Mom gets up early every day to prepare a nutritious breakfast, so that we start the day full of energy.

examples.chinese: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
examples.pinyin: Dànhuáng yuèbǐng de yíngyǎng fēngfù, kěshì bùnéng duō chī, bùrán hěn róngyì fāpàng.
examples.english: Egg yolk mooncakes are rich in nutrition, but you can't eat too many, otherwise you'll easily gain weight.

examples.chinese: 學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng tígōng gè shì gè yàng de yíngyǎng shípǐn, gōng xuéshēng tiāoxuǎn.
examples.english: The school cafeteria provides a variety of nutritious foods for students to choose from.

examples.chinese: 運動選手在參加比賽前，補充營養的飲食很重要。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng xuǎnshǒu zài cānjiā bǐsài qián, bǔchōng yíngyǎng de yǐnshí hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: Before athletes participate in a competition, a diet that replenishes nutrition is very important.

items.wordHook: Combining 營(camp) and 養(raise): 營養 means nutrition.
Combining 幽(quiet) and 默(silent): 幽默 means humorous.
Combining 話(speech) and 題(forehead): 話題 means topic.
Combining 農(agriculture) and 業(business): 農業 means agriculture.
